title: "TVA: Total VET Activity"
description: "Information about students undertaking Vocational Education and Training, collected by Registered Training Organisations."

Information about students undertaking Vocational Education and Training, collected by Registered Training Organisations.

*Defines Total VET Activity scope, source collections, recognised training and available data products.*
